OxyWare for Counter-Strike 1.6 non-Steam build 8684

1. Extract the entire ZIP to a folder. Keep OxyWare.exe and all DLLs together.
2. Start Counter-Strike using the OpenGL renderer (-gl).
3. Run OxyWare.exe and select Start cheat.
4. Focus the game and press Insert to open the menu.

Triggerbot is under Miscellaneous. Bind a key beside Enable. Turn on Toggle key to switch Triggerbot on and off with each press; this disables Always active.

To remove OxyWare, close it and delete the extracted folder. Settings and logs remain in %AppData%\oxware for compatibility with existing configurations.
